competitive_landscape: The Thousand Islands are served by slow wooden boats and speedboats from Ancol and the marinas; Jakarta's coast is among the most congested in the world. There is no fast, clean, on-demand option on either the island runs or the inner-harbour hops — that relief layer is the open gap.

regulatory_note: Sea transport falls under Indonesia's KSOP / Directorate of Sea Transportation and the DKI Jakarta administration; operations run from established Ancol / Sunda Kelapa marina terminals.
seasonality: The wet season (Nov–Mar) brings rougher Java Sea conditions; the dry season (Apr–Oct) is calmer. The Thousand Islands runs are sheltered enough for year-round operation with foiling smoothing the chop.

summary: Jakarta pairs one of the world's most congested coastal mega-capitals with the Thousand Islands (Kepulauan Seribu) resort archipelago just offshore. Pioneer II suits the Thousand Islands runs and inner-harbour hops as an all-electric relief layer over a gridlocked coast; Quanta-LR's hybrid range extends the network to the outer Kepulauan Seribu and wider Java Sea corridors.
